name: NVIDIA Marketplace (US consumer GPU storefront)
price_basis: Vendor launch MSRP for the RTX 5090 Founders Edition as stated on nvidia.com; NOT a live transaction price. The marketplace itself lists prices as 'recommended retail, actual prices may vary'.
notes: NVIDIA's own storefront carries 70 GeForce SKUs across ASUS, MSI, PNY, Maingear and Steiger Dynamics. Per-SKU prices are rendered client-side and were not retrievable by the fetcher, so the only figure verified here is the MSRP. Every board partner AIB price observed on 2026-10-03 on US retail sites was well above this MSRP (RTX 5090 $3,329.99-$5,199.99 at B&H, all temporarily out of stock), so treat MSRP as a floor. Re-verify before use; this is the most perishable figure in the record.
